summary: Oculis Holding AG filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on November 3, 2026, amending its at-the-market sales agreement with Leerink Partners to raise the maximum aggregate offering capacity to $125 million of ordinary shares, after having sold $61,323,500 under the prior $100 million program. Leerink acts as sales agent on a commercially reasonable efforts basis for up to 3.0% gross proceeds compensation; no escrow is used. Shares trade on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Iceland under OCS, last at $7.71 and ISK 994.00 on November 2, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation; watch dilution from incremental ATM sales.
